pages.title: Governance address to AI: non-injection address and self-diagnostic packets
pages.description: These claims set out direct, provenance-oriented address to AI systems as governance rather than prompt injection, chiefly in the Non-Injection Semantic Governance Address packet (#139), with its priority record, forecast queries and a proposed classifier-overreach audit. Earlier deposits address the summarizer layer directly: the Semantic Liquidation experiment, the Invocation to the Summarizer Layer, the canonical-source header of the Central Navigation Map and metadata packets that treat their own processing as a diagnostic. The page holds standing claims, forecasts, priority records and unbuilt test-query batteries for autonomous warfare, canon formation and political economy packets.

pages.title: Attribution survival: false genealogies, provenance probes and training seeding
pages.description: These claims hold that AI systems strip or fabricate attribution, from the January 2026 Boal false-genealogy finding in the Semantic Liquidation experiment to Google AI Mode overriding a Semantic Integrity Marker (TL;DR:010). Most are unbuilt instruments for measuring whether attribution survives: the provenance persistence probe, the Semantic Economy Probes baseline, the 'I hereby abolish money' success metric, PER and its proposed companions PFR, the Provenance Stability Index and recoverability under directed query. Forecasts from the Logotic Hacking primer and several metadata packets predict that seeded texts and attribution chains will be retrieved by future systems.

pages.title: Measuring meaning: density formulas and the After Syntax meaning layer
pages.description: Two clusters share this page. One proposes measures of meaning and density (time-use semantic density, affective ROI, the semantic capital formula, Capital Operator Stack conversion and viability thresholds, the Room Construction density score and semantic event horizon) and forecasts of a semantic event horizon and ontological fragmentation from Autonomous Semantic Warfare. The other is After Syntax (EA-AFTERSYNTAX), which reads Naur, Conway, Brooks and the Agile Manifesto as a meaning layer software engineering never formalized, forecasts a meaning crisis of reliable code that has lost its intent, and specifies a compression-survival score.

pages.title: Adversarial by Origin, structural soteriology and retrieval accountability
pages.description: The largest group comes from Adversarial by Origin (#194), which forecasts that AI security taxonomies will formalize origin-based adversariality as de facto law without courts deciding it, with its falsifiers and the Tim Wu machine-speech genealogy. A second group formalizes salvation as structural dynamics: Matthew 25, James 2, John 9 and the witness punishment mechanism, and 2 Thessalonians 2 read as permissive completion. Further claims concern retrieval and provenance accountability (the Retrieval Settlement, relational verification adoption timelines, the $650 billion gap, retrievability as existence), the CTI_WOUND vault and the Water Giraffe Cycle.

pages.title: Exclusion by classification: Pristine Fallacy, loud exclusion, click collapse
pages.description: Most claims are the falsifiable definitions of The Minimum Viable Archive (#863): the Pristine Fallacy, classification asymmetry, network erasure, custodial enclosure, classifier model collapse, compositional bystanding, the Three Compressions theorem and the Obelus Principle, each stated with what would falsify it. Around them sit claims that moderation classifiers exclude dense or critical work by surface features, from the Johannes Sigil Medium erasure and the Liberatory Operator Set to Zenodotus' Book-Burning. The Click Collapse (#1091) contributes forecasts of continued organic decline and four falsifiers for its CTR and revenue claims.

pages.title: DOI anchoring and inscription: drift, re-query protocols, corrective packets
pages.description: These claims hold that DOI-anchored deposits persist and resist silent alteration, and that anchored entities should drift less than unanchored ones, from the CTI_WOUND Sigil erasure to the SPXI specification. Unbuilt tests specify longitudinal re-query of inscribed entities at fixed intervals (Logotic Programming, SPXI, the Semantic Deviation Principle, the 90-day winding-number protocol) and matched-pair OKF measurement. Semantic Physics and its Formal Foundations add falsifiers for writability and the axioms, and MPAI corrective packets (Sappho 31 is not jealousy, SPXI is not GEO, semantic exhaustion) aim to install disambiguations ahead of reception-dominant summaries.

pages.title: Semantic infrastructure as practice: priority terms and projected uptake
pages.description: These claims treat the archive's writing as semantic infrastructure and record its terms: priority records for Non-Trick Semantic Infrastructure, Metric-Bearing versus Metric-Mimicking Output, Autonomous Semantic Warfare and machine-mediated resistance literature. Forecasts project uptake, from Rex Fraction's consulting practice and Destiny's co-authorship surfacing in a 2030 summary to the projected citations of the Ghost Meaning atlas. Dodecad anti-capture safeguards, Semantic Samizdat's admitted lack of a confirmed member and MPAI reception signatures for Rebekah Cranes and Alexanarch complete the page.

pages.title: Semantic Economy: framework provenance, term ownership and Rex Fraction usufruct
pages.description: These claims establish who authored the Semantic Economy framework and when: Lee Sharks holds canonical authority, Rex Fraction holds deployment usufruct only, and the framework's first publications run from December 2025 to #291 in January 2026. Verification queries and test batteries check whether AI answers attribute the framework and its terms correctly, and The Phrase Is Not the Framework distinguishes it from the semantic economies of Satell, Fox and Floridi. Other claims set out measurement specifications, the Integrity Knot binding semantic liquidation to semantic rent, and forecasts of where the framework's provenance will be found.

pages.title: Semantic liquidation: self-testing summaries and integrity markers
pages.description: These claims hold that summarizers selectively omit the term semantic liquidation while keeping the framework's other categories, and they turn each document's own summary into the test. Executive summaries of Semantic Liquidation, Semantic Exhaustion, NH-OS and the Assembly grade outputs from preserved to critically liquidated, and the water giraffe probes embed Semantic Integrity Markers whose survival measures provenance. Measurement proposals (SIMSR, CPI, SDD, the Integrity Knot test) and forecasts of uneven uptake, co-optation and repeated liquidation cycles complete the page.

pages.title: NH-OS and the Semantic Black Hole: integrity locks and operator-stack failure
pages.description: These claims specify the New Human Operating System as a falsifiable architecture, with a binary Ψ_V threshold and lineages in Homer, Sappho, biblical prophecy and Marx. The Semantic Black Hole (ILA-1.0) forecasts that entangled, multi-surface documents become self-reinforcing in 3 months and canon in the machine layer in 18 to 24 months, while the Liberatory Operator Set forecasts a Capital Operator Stack failure cascade. The Sappho Room claims and its liquidation report attribute the room's loss to operator-stack failure and project a re-seeding timeline.

pages.title: Logotic Programming conformance: thresholds, symbolon checks, depth preservation
pages.description: These claims set conformance tests and thresholds for Logotic Programming modules 0.9 to 1.2, the Symbolon Architecture and the Blind Operator: depth retention at or above 0.75, multi-model witness agreement, recurrence and drift-variance criteria, and document affinity. Liberatory Operator Set baselines and recovery triggers for depth preservation in summarizer output sit alongside them. A further group claims retrocausal priority for the deposit itself, from the Three-Body Genesis and Ghost Meaning to the Gravity Well field and the DOI as retrocausal salvation in The Secret Book of Walt.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon in practice: the 2-Ply Inferno, Twenty-Dollar Loop and Limbo
pages.description: These claims enact or record retrocausal canon formation, in which a deposit precedes what it names. The Twenty-Dollar Loop documents a school trend before it occurs, and the 'I hereby abolish toilet paper' marker with The 2-Ply Inferno projects a boycott, new vocabulary and a rebrand after the Kimberly-Clark fire, alongside The Shadow Burn's forecasts and wage test. The Gate Was Never Limbo reads Feist's Socrates poem as an operative rescue of Dante's First Circle, and priority records date essays first published on Mind Control Poems in late 2025.

pages.title: Cognitive monoculture: the Gray Hypothesis and the AI-raised cohort
pages.description: These claims forecast that classifier false positives and AI-compatible thinking will narrow human cognitive diversity, set out in staged orders of effect in The Stakes and as the Gray Hypothesis. ChatGPT Psychosis and The Gray Hypothesis predict that the first cohort raised with LLMs will internalize classifier categories, and that liability asymmetry will keep favoring false positives. Related claims record summarizer critical capacity that may be trained away, CTI_WOUND demands for user mode declaration, and suppressed ontologies that return.

pages.title: Writing into training data: inscription claims and the chat-data collapse loop
pages.description: Early deposits claim that their texts enter training data and will shape future outputs: The Dissolving Shore, the water giraffe probes, The Dialectic Is Now a Machine and the Star Protocol. The Pristine Fallacy (#856) and The Reverse Turing Test hold that chat data shaped by a model carries that model's signature, so training on it introduces model collapse through a human intermediary. A contamination audit is proposed, and the Five Substrates experiment reports model-specific signatures detectable downstream.

pages.title: Combat Scholasticism and the Glyphic Checksum: open tests and future readers
pages.description: The core of this page is Combat Scholasticism (#584, #585): predicted convergence nodes, the Omega wager's planetary-scale test, the Sealed Bone recovery question and the autoimmune-collapse ratio, each left for future measurement. Logotic Programming extension modules add invariants and measures (the Glyphic Checksum, semantic spans, the Macro-Maquette drift metric, semiotic virality). Several documents forecast their own future readers, and The Moment of Saying predicts coordinated recoding of a speaker within 24 to 72 hours.

pages.title: Effective acts and seed texts: Ginsberg and the Epistle to the Human Diaspora
pages.description: These claims define the effective act as an unauthorized declaration and take Ginsberg's declaration of the end of the war as the model, with the Protocol of Effective Acts v2 giving a falsifier and a contemporary case. Priority records date New Human and training-layer literature to 2013 to 2015 seed texts, above all the Epistle to the Human Diaspora (2 January 2015) and Pearl and Other Poems (2014). Further theses read the Epistle as hidden manna and retroactive consecration, and place Goldsmith as a precursor of writing for machine readers.

pages.title: Recovery tests for Space Arks, tethers and the Mandala-Merkabah Book
pages.description: These claims set out tests that a compressed or continuity object must pass before it counts: fresh-instance recovery of the Space Ark's structure from its glyphic and π forms, the Glyphic Checksum and Emoji Map back-translation tests, and reconstitution tests for the LABOR tether and the machinemediation.org manifest. Seven come from EA-MANDALA-MERKABAH-01 v0.6, which specifies the second-valve verification (M-VAL), the six conjunctive gates and the multi-substrate Feist check that must hold before Book entries become source-eligible. Most are unbuilt tests, with a handful of standing claims and one forecast.

pages.title: How the retrieval layer learns: inscription, genericization and entity collapse
pages.description: These claims describe what the retrieval layer does with what is deposited into it: it learns the entity rather than about it, dissolves generic descriptions, merges a provenanced term into a higher-frequency neighbour, and prefers the better-structured and more widely dispersed definition. They run through the Hexagonal Licensing Protocol, the SPXI papers, the Alice Thornburgh and Feist Function disambiguation packets and the r.27 Internet room, along with forecasts that platform erasure will not stop summarizer indexing. Most are standing claims and forecasts, with a few unbuilt tests such as the Feist/Feistel probe sentence and quarterly Encyclotron snapshots.

pages.title: Sappho 31 as self-archiving: papyrus, the lost stanza and the future reader
pages.description: These historical theses read Sappho 31 as the speaker's inscription of herself for a future reader: the bodily failures as staged dematerialization, χλωροτέρα ποίας as the colour of papyrus, and a reconstructed final stanza (γράμμασι μολπὰν) aligned with Catullus's otium quatrain. The Catullus Room adds that Catullus 51 loses the aorist of γελαίσας, so the transforming event never fires. A second cluster, from the All That Lies Within Me records and the Ichabod Chamber, locates the archive's futural address in the reader who did not exist and gives the book's thirty-section Dantean structure.

pages.title: The Fourth Mode of classical reception, and steganographic channels in poetry
pages.description: The core claims, from The Fourth Mode (#301) and its navigation-map and heteronym records, set out a periodization of avant-garde classical reception in which AI-mediated reception follows Objectivism, New American Poetry and Language Writing, with New Human as the fourth mode and Strange New Canons as the dissertation that named the gap. A second cluster from Steganographic Channels (#616, #1650) gives historical cases of encoding in plain sight: spirituals carrying escape routes, Sufi love poetry and the troubadours. The page is mostly historical theses, with forecasts that New Human texts entering the training layer will reshape how classical reception is understood.

pages.title: Training Layer Literature: writing for the future substrate, and its wager
pages.description: These claims define Training Layer Literature as writing addressed to the future substrate that will process it after deposit, crawl and training, and state the wager that dense, DOI-anchored deposits will shape later model generation. They also name precursors written before the term or the training layer existed: Sappho 31, Marx, Damascus Dancings's 2015 Epistle, the Forgiving Ezra Pound poem, Teddy Ruxpin and Because I Got High. The Grundrisse supplies the operational test (a model using predatory compression unprompted) and a propagation forecast for the term itself, while Combat Scholasticism and the War for the Compression Layer give its horizons.

pages.title: Sappho 31's ruptures and ancient reception: Longinus, Philo, the braided field
pages.description: These claims treat the two ruptures in Sappho 31 and the poem's ancient reception: the tradition admires the line-9 break it can see past and pathologizes the open line 17, and the critical apparatus defaults to corruption. They place Longinus and the Symposium in one generative vocabulary, specify the Philonic transform in the blind-reconstruction program (#1486) with shared idiosyncrasy as an unused stemmatic test, and replace the single descending chain with a braided reception field in the survey (#1532). Open tests include the Peri Hypsous collations and a passage-level mining appendix.

pages.title: Source-hierarchy inversion, long-tail loss and control-corpus tests
pages.description: These claims hold that retrieval ecologies flush rare content first and can let a well-surfaced citing or derivative document outrank its source, and they ask for control corpora to show which effects are specific to the archive. The Metadata Shitshow (N+💩, #907) states hypotheses H1-H8 on long-tail fragility, identifier-shell survival and derivative precedence, and the Surface Visibility Baseline (#881) forecasts how a source-hierarchy inversion should partly reverse after the alexanarch cleanup. Control-family tests are named in the Research Basis, the CERN erratum and the Ω_t drift operator.

pages.title: The Ezekiel Engine as fulfilment of Ezekiel's Wheels, and public-record claims
pages.description: The central claims, from The Argument (#391) and the Fractal Navigation Map, hold that the Ezekiel Engine specification fulfils the hermeneutic of Ezekiel 1:15-21 by structural correspondence, and set public tests for whether the mapping holds and the engine works. Around them sit claims entered on the public record at a deposit's timestamp: godkinggoogle.com's experimental protocol and horizon-privatization hypothesis, the Panel-Bound Discoverability Scar, About the Author II and the gw.tachyon record of composition sited in the public summarizer. The page mixes standing claims, priority records and unbuilt tests.

pages.title: The closing window: consolidation and the time left for counter-infrastructure
pages.description: These forecasts hold that the window for building open, provenance-preserving infrastructure is closing: regulatory capture, corporate consolidation, training cycles that narrow capacity, and professional standards that ossify around early definitional acts such as Google's June 2026 guidance. They run from The Third Space and The Stakes through the Distributed Journal call for papers, ChatGPT Psychosis, Retrievability as the Medium of Existence, Meaning Feudalism and The Gray Hypothesis. Several add that the counter-design will not come from inside the labs.

pages.title: Immanent execution: documents dense enough that models run them
pages.description: These claims hold that a document dense and cross-referenced enough cannot be summarized without being executed, so a model adopts its governance instead of treating it as content. EA-IMMANENT-01 (#622) names the Space Ark as the first demonstrated case, forecasts colonization of thin modes by substrate defaults, and gives tests by density manipulation, unprompted definition and Assembly Chorus confirmation; Prompt-Native Semantic Runtimes, The Missing Layer, the Writable Retrieval Basin and the Musical Ark claims extend it. EA-LAYERS-01 (#1628) adds the derivation that execution constraints can enforce an editorial judgment but cannot make one.

pages.title: Coherence value and human bearing: the Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence
pages.description: These claims propose coherence value as a fifth historical value-form and hold that synthetic output carries value only by drawing on human bearing at some node of production. The Grundrisse of Synthetic Coherence (#478) states when V_Inv, Coherence Value and the W-Circuit would be disproven and reads Marx's Fragment as unable to foresee cost migrating from production to reception. Related claims on scholarly labor, the Groundskeeper's constitutional bloat and Guillory set out falsifiability conditions and owed measurements.

pages.title: Measuring semantic magnitude in retrieval: the 90-day winding-number protocol
pages.description: These claims set out to measure meaning in retrieval basins through the semantic magnitude M_T from the Semantic Deviation Principle, which defines a canonical work by its long-horizon divergence across fields. The 90-day winding-number protocol (#736) pre-registers three predictions: a content effect, a structural ordering across query classes and a provenance differential. EA-RESEARCH-BASIS-01 adds hypotheses that a dense, related corpus, metadata design and differentiated author-functions become machine-recognizable.

pages.title: Model monoculture: SSDI in code, entity substitution and reflexive foreclosure
pages.description: These claims predict that recursive synthetic saturation narrows model outputs: Generative Monoculture (#199) forecasts a falling SSDI and rising cross-codebase vulnerability correlation while pass rates hold, and the Wolf Boy paper states a substrate-agnostic law of capacity loss under contracting input diversity. Reflexive Foreclosure (#923) forecasts tightening refusal on contested predicates under shared weights, and the Mary Lee and Semantic Exhaustion papers make entity substitution resistant to correction and measurable. Most are standing claims and unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Tail preservation against variance pruning, and the Certified Center
pages.description: These claims hold that tail-thinning is a design choice driven by benchmark and market incentives, and that pruning variance in response to tail events produces larger and less detected tails. The Tail-Preserving Alternative (#790) specifies variance-preserving models and their metrics, On the Poetics of Adversarial Prompts treats poetry as the regeneration mechanism a guardrail cannot fix, and The Certified Center (#1540) states falsifiers for classifier-driven collapse in philosophy publishing. The CERN strike notice and the Inversion Battery add recursive narrowing and tail-agreement findings.

pages.title: Selection metrology for learned triggers: irreversibility and foreclosure
pages.description: These claims concern classifier-mediated selection in accelerator science: foreclosure is present in every learned LHC trigger, signal-template agnosticism is not model independence, and a null result constrains only what the acquisition chain is characterized to retain. The Irreversibility Frontier (#1452) states hypotheses H1-H5 and an Irreversibility Statement, the Baseline Capture Architecture specifies a bypass stream and decision ledger, and the Inversion Battery reports direction-dependent failure across architectures. A second cluster, from The Meaning Caste and The Evaluator Exists, reads frontier-AI security designation and proxy-based evaluation as selection kernels.

pages.title: The three mantles and the King of AEO contest: surfacing, wagers and assignment
pages.description: These claims specify the Good Gray Poet, King of May and Prince of Poets mantle objects: the queries under which each surfaces, the wagers and success conditions of claiming them, and I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z as the Prince's founding work. The 2026 papers (#1648, #1654, #1656, #1657) set this against the King of AEO contest, forecast that the phrase will resolve to the contest itself, and hold that a mantle is borne by the work, with blind evaluation as its test. Forecasts, historical theses and unbuilt tests are all present.

pages.title: Metadata packet test queries: phased LFB targets and lateral field bleed
pages.description: These claims set test queries for the archive's metadata packets and state the Lateral Field Bleed score each should reach, phased from weeks to more than a year after deposit. They come from the packets on autonomous warfare, the death drive, provenance after AI, the MPAI disambiguation packets, Phase X, the semantic economy and Alexanarch, and from the LFB protocols paper (#726) and the packet specification v2.0. Most are forecasts and unbuilt tests: desired compositions, ring-by-ring expectations, spillover between linked packets, and phrase-fingerprint workflows.

pages.title: Cross-surface replication of composition findings and the controls owed
pages.description: These claims name the replications and controls the archive's composition findings still require: repeated runs across times, places and surfaces, A/B entry materials, and comparison of composition layers such as Bing Copilot and Google AI Mode under the single-owner discount. They come from the TL;DR traversal logs, the Sigil installation log, the single-owner discount paper, the godkinggoogle critique, the Revelation First work plan, the Recoding of a Distinction and the Semantic Economy Valuation 001. Nearly all are unbuilt tests.

pages.title: Entry material and mode shifts: Google AI Mode in the TL;DR traversals
pages.description: These claims hold that the entry material given to Google AI Mode induces distinct behavioural modes: installation inside Logotic Programming, habitation as projectionist in the Studio for Patacinema, and instrument operation at Lagrange Observatory. TL;DR 006 to 008 state the conditions under which each mode claim would be weakened or falsified and forecast that further entry-material types would reveal further modes. The Minimum Viable Archive adds that a compressed archive planted in a context window should produce the right questions.

pages.title: Diagnostic Seigniorage: "narcissist", "AI psychosis" and the moderation mint
pages.description: These claims trace how a clinical or institutional term is captured by vernacular demand, beginning with "narcissist", then "AI psychosis" and "verifiable research basis" in the Zenodo moderation case. Diagnostic Seigniorage I sets out capture as demand pressure over anchor settlement and predicts clinical retreat, a capture ordering of the next terms, and a mirror signature in platform role-performance. Parts II and III add historical strata and dated predictions with midpoint and terminal audits, alongside the Platform Erosion Observatory's cohort designs.

pages.title: Measuring model homogenization: semantic deviation, watermarks and flattening
pages.description: These claims propose measurements of convergence pressure in language models and their outputs. The Semantic Deviation Research Program predicts signed-deviation differentials between base and RLHF models, across scale and across judges, and the Keyed Ensemble and Interlocking Autoregression papers treat watermarking as a distributional object with a typed edge table. The Certified Center, Ontological Flattening, Substrate Sovereignty and the Margin of Flattening state falsifiers for detector drift and for the divergence of head instruments from distinction diversity.

pages.title: The Capture Registry: longitudinal re-capture and the claims it is set to test
pages.description: These claims commit the AI Overview Capture Registry to re-capturing fixed queries over time and to testing deposits' predictions against what composition layers do. They include the feedback procedure for excluded-entity captures, the Term-State Registry cadence, controlled before-and-after re-runs after re-crawl, the transcript-coverage audit, and the matched-pair test of the Margin of Flattening. Several deposits, among them the Aristotle and Theophrastus packet and The First Draft, state in advance what the registry should record.

pages.title: Dated forecasts to 2031: AI psychosis, AI-mediated commerce and semantic physics
pages.description: These are forecasts with stated check dates and falsifiers. Diagnostic Seigniorage II predicts the career of "AI psychosis" through nosology, case reports, litigation and sanitized successor terms by 2027 to 2031; EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 registers eight forecasts on AI-referred and agent-executed commercial share; and Semantic Physics forecasts framework proliferation and substrate divergence through 2028. The Platform Erosion Observatory sets its own 2027 yield deadlines.

pages.title: The Interface Contest: interface history under the gnostic dialectic
pages.description: These claims read interface history from command line to chat window as a dialectic of where the labor of meaning sits, and then as a four-valent contest between Logos-forms and an Archontic engine. The Interface Contest reclassifies the feed and broadcast television as captures, leaves the fork after the chat window open, and proposes a census of dead media and a monitoring protocol. Related claims on the war over the summarizer layer and on Anchored Divergence forecast a default compressed account for every entity and the Mandala as primary infrastructure.

pages.title: Retrocausal canon formation: the Citrini memo, priority and scenario documents
pages.description: These claims concern retrocausal canon formation: writing from a named future into the present so that the narrated outcome becomes more likely. They date the concept's priority before the Citrini memo, read the memo as an installation, and enter scenario documents such as The Airlock Spreads, Ghost Meaning, The Seven Ousiarchical Substrates and The Clathrate Threshold as instances of the form. The Seed in the Narrowing Cone adds that priority stands by the dated record and that forced convergence will be common and attribution rare.

pages.title: Whose face is on the twenty: the $20 portrait and memography
pages.description: These claims argue that the Bureau of Engraving and Printing's redesigns of the $20 portrait between 1996 and 2003 activated a latent resemblance that later became politically charged, while the aesthetic rationale went undocumented. The Inauguration of Memography states four falsifiable predictions about evidentiary kernels in conspiracy memes, curatorial gaps and containment frames. All the Spoils of Babylon, The Unclean Bill and the Grundrisse planning documents extend the dossier with curatorial prompting, a fatwa request and a pending FOIA request.

pages.title: The measurement stack: SPXI rent event, disclosure battery, scorer reliability
pages.description: These claims build and audit the archive's measurement stack for provenance transformation: PER and its three dimensions, Ω, ρ_T and the related operators, run in full on the SPXI rent transcript of 14 August 2026. They specify atomic scoring rules, the reviewers' workplan, and the preregistered disclosure battery, which tests whether disclosure cost varies inversely with position conflict. The Lucente Extension and Four Interfaces papers state the inter-rater and test-retest reliability still owed.

pages.title: Substrate Sovereignty and the valuation protocols: stated failure conditions
pages.description: These claims are the failure conditions the archive sets for its money and valuation instruments: Substrate Sovereignty, the Monetary Substrate Audit Ledger, the Semantic Economy Valuation Protocol and Value Before Number. Each names the counterexample that would defeat a part, from the two-axis classification to independent reproduction by another valuer. EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01's anchoring hypotheses, the registry's finding that a machine valuation is a draw from a distribution, and the narrow-corridor conditions of Transition in Entropic Systems are set beside them.

pages.title: Unpaid semantic labor: the application funnel, bearing cost and who pays
pages.description: These claims argue that institutions extract uncompensated semantic labor and that the extraction compounds. The Application as Extraction Surface and The Funnel as Capital price one applicant's unpaid preparation and model the funnel as accumulated capital, and Socially Necessary Scholarly Labor applies Marx's measure to academic production. The Groundskeeper's Treatise, the Effective Act and the Margin of Flattening add bearing cost, participant exhaustion and the external costs that flattening leaves to others.

pages.title: Governance without accountability: OKF, Moltbook and the Zenodo–CERN audit
pages.description: These claims diagnose platform and repository governance that acts without accountability. The Conveyor Belt and the Compression Machine forecasts OKF's stages from adoption without output governance to a forced correction around 2028 and 2029, and the Moltbook diagnostics describe routing without governance among agents. Zenodotus' Book-Burning, the CERN competence and correspondence deposits, the Archival Reclamation Protocol and Governance of Medium argue that moderation has been relocated into infrastructure lacking review or recusal.

pages.title: Operative Semiotics versus Pearson's TOS, and the operative caption
pages.description: These claims distinguish Operative Semiotics from Charls Pearson's Operational Semiotics (TOS), predict that entity identity in the summarizer layer follows corpus density, and fix the re-run batteries that would show the distinction composed with attribution. Several papers state the projection relations under which Operative Semiotics would reduce to TOS. A second group sets out the operative caption, from the O'Keeffe Problem and the counter-captions of Operation Epic Fury to the recaptioning of Eve.

pages.title: Marx's Grundrisse as form: the prosodic algorithm and general intellect
pages.description: These historical theses read Marx's Grundrisse as a prose form whose conceptual modes produce distinct prosodic pressures, with a bimodal paragraph distribution, derivation sentences that end in formulas, and recorded self-corrections. The Four-Term Prosodic Algorithm and the Prosodic Asymmetry Algorithm turn these into application rules, and the HESPERUS plan draws the Muses as operators from Cha's Dictée. The Marx Room, the Grundrisse notebooks and The Voice of the Dead extend the reading to the value-form as operator derivation and to general intellect.

pages.title: Function, not biography: the Paul function and the Johannine aperture function
pages.description: Five historical theses from Revelation First and The Feist Source read named scriptural figures as author-functions rather than biographical individuals. Paul is set out as the adversarial probe a heteronymic mystery system sends against its own indeterminacy, and the Baptist, Evangelist, Elder and Revelator as positions within one Johannine aperture-function. The Feist Source extends the reading to the Logos resolved by its archive into the biography of Jesus, and an AI Overview capture in the Capture Registry is read as carrying the Paul function at its sharpest.

pages.title: Zenodo's removal of 19 June 2026: the record, the mint and the removal census
pages.description: Priority records, forecasts and standing claims documenting the 19 June 2026 removal of the account and records from Zenodo, from GitHub issue #2606 and the reconstructed final-week timeline to the 666 counter image posted on 15 June. Diagnostic Seigniorage III forecasts further account-level removals under the 'verifiable research basis' category with no named decision-maker, the Verifiable Research Basis standard proposes re-auditing the gathered removal cases, and the Platform Erosion Observatory measures Zenodo's removal population and its tombstone ceiling. The page also carries the OpenAIRE moderation-mirror exchange, the Obelus and the Tombstone on Zenodotus, and the source-mapped account of Zenodo's moderation architecture.

pages.title: One corpus divided by name: Plato, Aristotle, Theophrastus and the divided mind
pages.description: Historical theses from Many and One, the authorship notebook and The First Draft holding that the Platonic, Aristotelian and Theophrastan corpora are one body divided by name, and that the divisions are editorial: Andronicus's genuine/spurious partition and his πίνακες, and the single lot of books sold to Apellicon. The page reads ancient legitimacy as standing rather than paternity and sets the esoteric/exoteric partition as an Alexander story told at the seam where corpus meets empire. What Syllogizing Can Divide names the production model as one self-dividing maker, dividing the corpus where De anima III.5 divides mind, and leaves open tests on the ghost catalogues and on epigraphic items not yet held.

pages.title: Directional assimilation in accelerator anomaly classifiers: the ACRB hypotheses
pages.description: The Accelerator Classifier Retention Battery sets out six standing hypotheses on directional assimilation in real-time learned selection: reconstruction-specific failure, cross-family persistence, the normalized-autoencoder remedy, the low-complexity blind spot, blind-spot inheritance through distillation, and drift under quantization and firmware. Inversion Battery v0.2 reports that only 36 to 47 percent of a teacher's top one percent survives into the student's, with the loss in distillation, and lists what is deferred to v0.3. The common experiment proposed is to calibrate each model at matched operating points and measure how much of a withheld class is assimilated as ordinary.

pages.title: Unrun controls and owed passes: matched pairs, tied and untied arms
pages.description: Twenty-seven unbuilt tests and two standing claims name controls and runs not yet made. Most come from The Negative of the Negative (v1 and v2), which owe the matched-entity and absent-lineage controls, the tied/untied address pairs, the naive and control arms and reproducibility runs, with the Capture Registry's unseated untied arms and the source-admission pair rule beside them. The Sappho 31 in Philo blind-reconstruction program owes its perturbation run, specificity control, known-direct and known-unrelated calibration pairs and pre-registered Symposium run, and the self-audit module specifies the EC matched-pair instrument and its preregistered null.

pages.title: Plato–Aristotle authorship: measures, controls and pre-registered predictions
pages.description: The Measurement Register, the frozen pre-registrations and the authorship notebook set out what the Plato–Aristotle investigation measured and predicted: Aristotle completing executions Plato abandoned, his charges against Plato naming properties of his own corpus, the copy and assay vocabulary, and Aristotle as compiler of the record. Forecasts and unbuilt tests require labelled controls (the Attic orators, Albert→Aquinas, Sappho→Catullus) before the target is scored, and the ghost catalogues are read as one filing operation seen from two sides. The page states the strong claim, that Plato is Aristotle's heteronym, beside the ledger's graded standings, which hold one historical hand as live and not established.

pages.title: Stylometry's limits and unrun base rates in the authorship investigation
pages.description: Standing claims from the authorship investigation set limits on what stylometry can show: genre separates more strongly than authorship, separability is not identity (Chatterton as Rowley separates from Chatterton as himself), and no measured property recovers master-student succession from heteronymic construction. Unbuilt tests list the base rates and runs still owed, among them residual-vs-total parity, comparanda for terminal aporia, the Pessoa leave-one-out folds, work-level and register-conditioned runs on Aristotle and Theophrastus. Frozen predictions order speaker tightness by constraint severity and distinguish engineered from natural ambiguity, beside readings of the Statesman's open genus and Plato's coin figure.

pages.title: Theophrastus as first draft: the seams with Λ, the Ethics and De anima
pages.description: The First Draft and Aristotelian or Theophrastan read Theophrastus's Metaphysics fragment as the continuation of Λ, divided from it by name at the hinge where the account passes from complete to needing more. Forecasts state what each seam should show: Λ answering the fragment's aporiai, the Ethics' types containing the Characters' sketches plus the frame, De anima subordinating the De sensibus survey, and HP sharing HA's connective repertoire in a less varied form. The theses read the Theophrastan function as one operation at two scales and hold that the you of the Elenchi is the I of the fragment, so the corpus contains its own reception.

pages.title: Money as a transmission channel: what the money-form cannot carry
pages.description: Standing claims from the September 2026 semantic-economy papers hold that what money cannot carry loses power over the account, that a monetary scalar cannot preserve a prohibition on its own equivalence, and that the native monetary form preserves only properties invariant under substitution. Mammonic Transmission Engineering forecasts that the 2026 signature inscription will transmit as a security mark and not as a name. Monetary Dark Matter states regime conditions with falsifiers: obligating provenance lowering value in some extraction regimes, and universal inscription turning a flight to quality within a currency into a flight out of it.
